WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) as count_per_city
  FROM address
  GROUP BY city_id
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(count_per_city) as avg_count
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.city_id,
    s1.count_per_city,
    s1.count_per_city / s2.avg_count as ratio
  FROM step1 s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 s2
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT SUM(count_per_city) as sum_count
  FROM step3
)
SELECT 
  s3.city_id,
  s3.count_per_city,
  s3.ratio,
  s3.count_per_city / s4.sum_count as final_ratio
FROM step3 s3
CROSS JOIN step4 s4
ORDER BY s3.count_per_city / s4.sum_count DESC
LIMIT 10
